newsitem.title: USA: Group cuts Western Water stake.
newsitem.headline: Group cuts Western Water stake.

text.p: A group including Durian Securities and Pengo Securities said Thursday it reduced its stake in Western Water Co to the equivalent of 538,580 common shares or 16.4 percent of the total outstanding.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it sold a net of 275,650 shares between August 31 and September 16.
The transactions include the purchase of 514,350 common shares between August 31 and September 16 at prices ranging from $10.9583 to $21.75 a share.
In addition, the group bought 2,500 preferred shares at $275.00 a share, which are convertible into 25,000 common shares.
The group said it also sold 815,000 common shares between September 11 and 16 at prices ranging from $17.625 to $18.00 a share.
The group, which includes investor Randall Smith, said it holds the stake in Western Water for investment purposes.
